test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

It’s ______ too late to start your own business.
solution:
The correct answer is: **never**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Never **means at no time in the past or future; not ever.
